input: I went to an out-of-network emergency room. Do I have to pay out-of-network prices?
warnings: This answer does not cite your plan documents. Check the sources below before relying on it.
output: Yes, you generally don't have to pay out-of-network prices for emergency care under most plans. It's important to verify that the emergency room billed you correctly based on your plan's coverage rules.
